recipes.title: Crispy Chicken & High-Protein Mac and Cheese with Chilli Yogurt

items.i: chicken breast (3 large), butterflied and halved

steps: Butterfly each chicken breast and cut it in half to make 6 even fillets. Toss with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, a pinch of salt and plenty of pepper.
Mix the Greek yogurt with the chilli sauce, salt and pepper. Put it in a squeeze bottle or small containers and refrigerate (don't reheat it).
Spread the panko on a tray. Whisk the eggs in a bowl. Dip each fillet in egg, then press it into the panko until fully coated. No flour needed.
Place on a lined, oiled tray and spray the chicken thoroughly with oil on both sides. Bake at 220°C / 390°F (or air fry) for 18–20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 74°C / 165°F inside.
Cook the macaroni in well-salted boiling water for 1 minute less than the packet says, then drain.
Gently warm the milk over medium heat (don't let it simmer). Add the cheddar, mozzarella and cheese slices and stir gently until melted, then stir in the Dijon and a pinch of salt.
Fold the drained macaroni through the sauce until creamy and stringy, and season with pepper.
Slice the chicken into strips. Divide the mac and cheese between 5 containers, top with the chicken, and add the chilli yogurt and parsley when serving.
recipes.notes: Amounts and the per-container macros (736 cal, 70 g protein, 65 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator. You'll have one fillet left over across 5 containers; either share it out or make 6 smaller portions.
